checks.label: Template/schema validation
checks.purpose: Checks whether the file matches a known contract.
checks.failureMode: Wrong template produces stranded or misread fields.

checks.label: Required-field validation
checks.purpose: Confirms the minimum fields needed for safe use.
checks.failureMode: Thin records pass without enough context.

checks.label: Accepted-value validation
checks.purpose: Checks fields such as status, criticality, and phase against allowed values.

checks.label: Quarantine checks
checks.purpose: Blocks records with missing, conflicting, unsafe, or unmapped data.

checks.label: Duplicate detection
checks.purpose: Identifies repeated objects and conflicting records.
checks.currentStatus: Available where object keys are present.
checks.failureMode: Duplicate systems or vendors inflate counts.

checks.label: Tenant isolation
checks.purpose: Confirms all objects are scoped to the active tenant.

checks.label: Candidate inactive checks
checks.purpose: Confirms candidate data does not become active by default.
checks.failureMode: Preview data is read by default modules.

checks.label: Promotion readiness
checks.purpose: Checks proof, blockers, approval, and rollback posture.
checks.failureMode: Eligible candidate is mistaken for promoted data.

checks.label: Rollback posture
checks.purpose: Confirms prior active state and rollback plan are documented.
checks.failureMode: No safe return path after promotion.

checks.label: Module readiness
checks.purpose: Checks whether modules can safely inspect or read the layer.

checks.label: Page wiring checks
checks.purpose: Confirms each page reads and writes only approved layers.
checks.failureMode: Page writes to the wrong layer.

checks.label: No example data as live facts
checks.purpose: Ensures illustrative rows are labeled as examples and not reported as tenant truth.
checks.failureMode: Example content becomes a live claim.

checks.label: No retired version-label UI language
checks.failureMode: Users see implementation history instead of product meaning.

cannotClaim: no realized savings without measured proof
no active tenant truth without active pointer
no candidate data in default Home
no uploaded-file count as data quality
